id: title:DanielVisca:paint the overview layout while its data loads

observations.behavior: Replaces static number rendering with conditional LemonSkeleton for loading state.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a consistent placeholder while metrics data is fetching, preventing layout shifts and preserving column alignment.

observations.behavior: Swaps the global Spinner component for the new MetricsOverviewSkeleton when no overview exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the loading indicator to match the actual metric card structure rather than a generic spinner.

observations.behavior: Uses shared label constants instead of hardcoded strings in JSX. This also enables reuse by the skeleton.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces risk of mismatch between loaded and placeholder labels; supports future configuration without changing multiple locations.
